1.consolidated_definition: Balsa de grandes dimensiones y de poco fondo, construida de maderos unidos, usada para transportar personas, vehículos o mercancías de una ribera a otra de ríos o puertos.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Large flat-bottomed raft constructed of joined timbers, used to transport people, vehicles, or cargo from one riverbank or port to another.
